# Click

> Click (App Store name "Click: Screenshot & Record") is a native macOS menu-bar app for capturing,
> marking up, redacting and recording the screen. One hotkey opens a capture overlay (region,
> window or screen); the capture is copied to the clipboard at once and opens in an annotation
> editor with one keypress. The same overlay records video with system audio, microphone and a
> camera bubble. No account. No cloud. Your captures stay on your Mac.

- Platform: macOS 14 Sonoma or later (microphone recording needs macOS 15); Apple silicon and Intel. Written in Swift on ScreenCaptureKit.
- Distribution: Mac App Store only. Version 1.0 is in App Review; not yet available.
- Category: Productivity (secondary: Graphics & Design).
- Pricing: Free $0 forever. Pro Monthly $4.99 with a 7-day free trial. Pro Yearly $47.99 with a 7-day free trial. Pro Lifetime $129, one payment, no trial.
- Free: region / window / screen capture, copy to clipboard, save as PNG, canvas background and drop shadow. No watermark.
- Pro: annotation tools, crop, redaction, screen recording, camera bubble, mic and system audio, Compare, the Library, HEIC / PDF / 2x export.
- Shortcuts: Cmd-` to capture, Shift-Cmd-` to record. Both are remappable in Settings > Hotkeys.
- Privacy: no account, no cloud upload. The app sends anonymous usage statistics (which tools are used, never what was captured); users can turn them off in Settings > General.
- Refunds: handled by Apple (reportaproblem.apple.com), since Click is sold only on the Mac App Store.

- https://sirryanlynch.github.io/click/privacy.html : privacy policy
